items.title: CISA: Attackers Breach Federal Agency via Critical GeoServer Flaw
items.description: Threat actors exploited CVE-2024-36401 less than two weeks after it was initially disclosed and used it to gain access to a large federal civilian executive branch (FCEB) agency that uses the geospatial mapping data.

items.title: Malicious SVGs in Phishing Campaigns: How to Detect Hidden Redirects and Payloads
items.description: Phishing campaigns are getting harder to spot, sometimes hiding in files you’d never suspect. ANY.RUN’s cybersecurity analysts recently uncovered one such case: a malicious SVG disguised as a PDF, hosted on a legitimate domain and packed with hidden redirects.
